req.title: Cookie name path segment escaping
req.statement: The system shall percent-decode the <name> and <value> path segments in /cookies/set/<name>/<value>.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should percent-decode the <name> and <value> path segments in the /cookies/set/<name>/<value> endpoint. This means that the endpoint should correctly handle URL-encoded characters in the path segments, setting the cookie with the decoded values. The test suite includes a positive test to verify correct behavior with valid input, a negative test to check behavior with invalid input, and a boundary test to ensure correct handling of edge cases.

tests.name: test_cookie_set_with_percent_decoded_values
preconditions: The httpbin app is running and accessible.
The client can send requests to the app.
actions: Send a GET request to /cookies/set/%61/%62%63 (percent-encoded 'a' and 'bc').
expected: The cookie 'a' is set with value 'bc'.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/cookies/set/%61/%62%63')
assert response.status_code == 302
assert response.headers['Location'] == '/cookies'
cookies_response = client.get('/cookies')
assert cookies_response.json == {'cookies': {'a': 'bc'}}

tests.name: test_cookie_set_with_invalid_path_segments
preconditions: The httpbin app is running and accessible.
The client can send requests to the app.
actions: Send a GET request to /cookies/set/%ZZ/%ZZ (invalid percent-encoding).
expected: The response indicates a client error due to invalid input.
trace: Client error due to invalid percent-encoding
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/cookies/set/%ZZ/%ZZ')
assert response.status_code == 400
assert b'Invalid percent-encoding' in response.data

tests.name: test_cookie_set_with_empty_name_and_value
preconditions: The httpbin app is running and accessible.
The client can send requests to the app.
actions: Send a GET request to /cookies/set// (empty name and value).
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/cookies/set//')
assert response.status_code == 302
assert response.headers['Location'] == '/cookies'
cookies_response = client.get('/cookies')
assert cookies_response.json == {'cookies': {}}
